limitations: Metadata is a point-in-time indication of platform embedding permission, not an end-to-end playback test.

recommendation.delivery: Ordinary YouTube privacy-enhanced embeds with permanent original-source links and the existing error fallback.
recommendation.caveat: No per-clip metadata exception found in this check; a platform-permitted embed does not constitute an independent underlying-rights opinion or prove successful playback.
recommendation.runtimeExceptions: Handle missing/private videos (100), owner-disabled embeds (101/150), and host/referrer configuration failures (153) distinctly when shown; do not substitute mirrors or bypass restrictions.
